description: Full-body native pixel-art game sprite, STRICTLY FRONT SOUTH view: face, nose, chest, belt and knees directly toward viewer, both ears equally visible. No sideways head or three-quarter turn. IDENTITY: Tall lean adult man with slightly slouched posture, long narrow pale face, pronounced dark under-eye shadows, tired half-lidded gray-brown eyes, small weary smile. LONG dark BROWN layered hair extending past shoulders, center part, long curved side locks and outward-flipped ends, untied. Navy suit, white shirt and navy tie. No mask. Relaxed upright stance, empty hands at sides. Natural adult anatomy, normal torso/pelvis, 7-head proportions. Anatomical crown to soles 230-238px; feet 6px above bottom, hair fully inside frame. Crisp single-pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained game-sprite shading, no antialiasing. Transparent background, no ground shadow, text or weapons. Preserve individual hair, face, stature and clothing. Do not copy any generic character. Anatomical height excludes high hair/headwear. Every outer edge must border transparency directly, never a light gray halo. Use target anatomical height at reference pixel scale. Feet at y250, crown around y16. Do not copy reference identity or body fat. Crucial: unbuttoned open white shirt collar showing lower neck and upper chest; loosened navy tie knot hangs below open collar. Dark charcoal-brown layered shoulder-length hair, sleepy tired grey eyes and under-eye shadows. Never closed buttoned collar, never neat tight tie.

style_image.usage_description: Use only native pixel rendering, standing scale and FRONT SOUTH pose. Preserve target individual identity, age, hair, face, build and clothes from description.
